stemMd: A shop has three boxes labelled “pens,” “pencils” and “mixed.” Every label is wrong. One item drawn from the box labelled “mixed” is a pen. What does that box contain?

options.label: D
options.textMd: A mixture of pens and pencils

explanationMd: The box labelled mixed cannot actually be mixed. It must therefore contain only pens or only pencils. Drawing a pen eliminates pencils-only, leaving pens-only. The key is choosing a box whose incorrect label excludes the mixed case.

distractorRationale.e: The observed pen rules this out.
distractorRationale.d: Its mixed label is known to be wrong.
distractorRationale.b: An item was drawn from it.
distractorRationale.c: The wrong-label condition and observed pen identify it.
